title: Fixed Radial Suspended Chair Ride
description: One newly authored complete static suspended-chair ride exterior. A broad grounded plinth and tall tapered central mast carry an upper collar, six real radial crown ribs and a continuous annular overhead chain carrier. Six whole thick seat-and-back shells hang beneath this ring, each on four continuous fixed suspension bars with two connected side armrests. There is no passenger deck, no horse-piercing upright pole and no horizontal observation-wheel axle: the new support route is entirely from mast to upper crown to suspended chair shells, rather than the old carousel platform or A-frame swing repeated as a scene. All numeric geometry is newly authored; chairs are components of one complete apparatus, never six extra models. Three opaque constant PBR roles, metres, native Z up and full horizontal-bounds-centred ground origin. One complete prop, zero scenes. Unoccupied stationary illustration only: no rotation, chains or ropes dynamics, full-travel clearance, restraints, passenger fit, load, stability, drive, manufacture, ride performance or safety claim.
